# Review Play 08

Findings first. Verify platform ownership, exported source, bindings, DLP,
identity, roles, approvals, audit, managed promotion, smoke, and rollback. Reject
tenant values, shared credentials, prompt-only authorization, rebuilt artifacts,
or outcome claims without versioned evidence.
